additional_info.subject: Issue DEsription
additional_info.body:
during commissioning we faced the issue that Chargerpoint 1 is not
available, after check we e saw that DC Meter Chargepoint 1 is
misaligned mounted and its showing date 10.02.2024, but its
connected to OCPP. We got Remote Support from L3, but the
colleague wasnt able to solve. We tried restart, reboot, checked the
configuration, checked the cable, all good.
We suggest to replace the DC meter 1, any recommendation from
your side?

additional_info.body:
Hi Alexander,
I apologise, the ticket was assigned to a colleague and was not visible to us.
I believe this is the LEM meter problem Naim reached out to me. We tried everything remotely and couldn't bring the LEM back to operation.
My suggestion is to replace it since there was not much we could do.
Let me know when the task is done, if everything is successfull just ping me. Otherwise, let's check together what might be the problem.
I will send this ticket to you since it needs to be resolved on-site. Do not hesitate to reach out to me.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
